title: Un-Banished
tagline: Banished 1.0.7, rebuilt, on your own copy of the game. Choose the game and your files, then press Start.
fine: Banished is Shining Rock Software's (2014). Un-Banished ships none of its files: it reads your own copy where it is installed.

sections.label: Banished's files
help: Not kept here: the game reads your copy where it is installed. Choose it in Settings, under Game files.
